errors.network: Couldn't complete the action. Check your connection and try again.
errors.action: Couldn't complete the action. Try again.
errors.server: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.evidenceFile: Only photos (JPG, PNG, WebP) and PDF documents up to 8 MB are accepted.
errors.documentFile: Only photos (JPG, PNG, WebP) and PDF documents are accepted.
errors.imageNetwork: Couldn't send the image. Check your connection and try again.

auth.wrongCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.emailNotVerified: You haven't confirmed your email yet. We just sent you the link again.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
auth.emailTaken: There's already an account with that email. Sign in.
auth.legalNotAccepted: To create your account you need to accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
auth.invalidLink: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
auth.banned: This account is suspended. Write to us if you think it's a mistake.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.sessionOld: For your safety, sign in again and do it right away.

live.offlineNote: No connection to the server; retrying

suspended.title: This account is suspended
suspended.body: The account {{name}} can't be used for now. If you think this is a mistake, write to us and we'll look into it.

nothing.title: No vehicles for you yet
nothing.body: When the account has vehicles within your scope, they'll show up here and on the map.

empty.title: Add your first GPS
empty.body: You need the device, a SIM with data and two minutes. We'll tell you what to set up and you'll see it appear on the map.

noDevice.title: No GPS connected
noDevice.body: This vehicle has no device. Connect one to see it on the map.

pending.title: Waiting for the first signal
pending.body: Set up the device so it reports to the platform.
pending.bodyMinutes: Set up the device so it reports to the platform. {{n}} min left.

unplug.title: Remove the GPS
unplug.body: The device {{id}} will stop reporting to your account and this vehicle's trip history will be deleted. You can connect another GPS later.

remove.title: Delete the vehicle
remove.body: {{name}}, its GPS and all its trip history will be deleted. This can't be undone.

parked.title: Parked mode
parked.on: Turned on {{since}}. Alerts you if it moves from here.
parked.off: Alerts you if the vehicle moves from where it is.

share.title: Share location
share.intro: Create a link so someone without an account can see where {{name}} is. It stops working when it expires, or when you revoke it.
share.created: Link created. Copy it now: for security it won't be shown again.
share.warning: Anyone with this link will see the live location. Send it only to whoever should see it.
share.noteHint: Only you see this, to recognize the link later.
share.none: None. No one outside can see this vehicle.
share.confirmRevoke: Whoever has this link stops seeing {{vehicle}}. This can't be undone.

consent.title: Terms and privacy
consent.body: To keep using the platform we need you to accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>. They explain what can be done with the service and how we handle your data.
consent.failed: Couldn't save your answer. Try again.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.intro: Your user {{email}} will be deleted and, with it, the accounts you own:
delete.vehicles: Their vehicles, GPS devices and all trip history.
delete.people: Their groups, invited users and activity log.
delete.final: The devices will stop reporting to the platform. This can't be undone.
delete.noPassword: You sign in with another service and have no password. If your session is not recent, sign in again and delete it right away.

wizard.addFailed: Couldn't add the GPS. Try again.
wizard.needName: Give it a name to recognize it on the map.
wizard.badId: Type the {{idLabel}} exactly as it appears on the device: letters and numbers only, no spaces.
wizard.name: Vehicle name
wizard.imeiHint: 15 digits. It's on the device label or its box.
wizard.idHint: It's on the device label. Usually 10 to 12 digits long.
wizard.firstSignal: We received its first signal. From now on you'll see it move on the map.
wizard.expired: Time ran out without a signal from this GPS, so it was released. Check the setup and add it again.
wizard.commandsNote: These are the usual {{brand}} commands. If your model uses others, look in its manual for how to change the server and port.

waiting.title: Waiting for the first signal…
waiting.updates: This window updates on its own when it reports.
waiting.updatesMinutes: This window updates on its own when it reports; you have {{n}} min to connect it.
